Physical -> element-neutral per THE PHYSICAL RULE; identity via geometry+ailment. Impale-> sunder (hit-applied damage-taken amp); bleed rider per probe. commit=wind-up (channel-then-release).

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: elem 'physical' -> THE PHYSICAL RULE: element-neutral (both slots null), identity carried by multi_projectile geometry + sunder/bleed ailments. Sanguimancy 'spells cost Life in addition to Mana' -> hp_cost_scale, CLAMPED to 0.30 LOCKED ceiling (source rate unquantified in fetched text; clamp+note per addendum B/review-book clamp list). Life-remnant kill-vacuum (addendum B) -> on_kill recovery keys; pickup-radius flavor noted. WATCH-ITEM FIRED: ES-overleech-above-cap -- 'healing above max life to 150%' is an above-max-life buffer; NO native economy key expresses an above-cap overheal reservoir -> docket-candidate filed (steward consolidates with grim-feast b02). Bonestorm is a general witch skill, NOT a Blood Mage capstone node (dossier source_note). Grasping Wounds (stagger damage over 4s) -> RETRIBUTION_ENGINE-adjacent defensive door. Impale->sunder per addendum A.
